description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for a restaurant menu screen, allowing users to view menu items and add them to a shopping cart.

classes.name: RestaurantMenuScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a restaurant's menu and provides functionality to add menu items to a shopping cart.

classes.name: _RestaurantMenuScreenState
classes.description: The state class for RestaurantMenuScreen managing menu fetching, loading state, and UI rendering.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and triggers fetching of the restaurant menu.
